title: The Pages workspace is a page index: every page in five lists, most important first, with an Edit button only where the block editor builds the page
detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19 (ADR-1760) on the owner's ask to clean up the Pages admin area: main site pages up front, the unlinked lead and SEO pages in their own list, a view-only index for pages with nothing to edit, most important first.

PREMISE RE-TESTED on main at c65c997. /pages drew four modules in the order In-app / Member, In-app / Focus surfaces, Funnels, Marketing pages. Every in-app row offered Open & edit (?edit=1), a parameter no page in the list reads (useEditMode is read on event pages only), so the link opened the page with nothing switched on. The Marketing list offered Edit on Home, The Community, Spaces, Pricing and Circles, whose bodies under the Frequency design are coded pages (the SITE_DESIGN branch in each route file), so the editor it opened produced a document the visitor never sees. The site's own pages that are not block-backed (Features, Vision, Help, Discover, the events calendar, Get started) and every system page (sign-in, legal, email) were not listed at all; the lead pages were mixed into the marketing list with no sign that nothing links them.

BUILT. lib/pages/index-catalog.ts is the catalog: Site pages (the site nav's own links), Lead and SEO pages (reached from search, a share or a campaign), System pages (fixed copy). Each row carries `editor` (blocks, coded, live, help, funnel, fixed), the truth of what produces the body; block rows derive from EDITABLE_PAGES, so enrolling or retiring a slug there adds or removes the row, and the five design-switched slugs read coded on a Frequency build. The workspace renders five modules in order: Site pages, Lead and SEO pages, Funnels, In-app pages, System pages. Every list shows for admin+; only a janitor gets Edit, and only on a blocks row (or the Funnels link on the Get started row). The in-app list is one table (Member, then Focus surfaces), each row naming what the page's own Settings button edits (Layout, header, SEO on a module route; header, SEO elsewhere) with View only; a patterned row (one page per Space) carries no View. pages-in-app-focus is retired; pages-marketing keeps its id for saved layouts and draws the Site list.

NOT DONE HERE, for the Editor program (PROG-E4) and the marketing trim (SCAN-1017): the coded site pages have no block editor, and the index says so rather than pretending; the trim's removals (what-is-frequency, tools-for-community-builders) drop out of the index with their EDITABLE_PAGES rows.

PROBE: the index catalog places the three lists in order, the in-app list no longer links ?edit=1, and the workspace registers the system list.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cat=fs.readFileSync('lib/pages/index-catalog.ts','utf8');const inapp=fs.readFileSync('components/widgets/pages/pages-in-app.tsx','utf8');const mods=fs.readFileSync('lib/widgets/modules.ts','utf8');const order=['site','lead','system'].map(id=>cat.indexOf(\"id: '\"+id+\"'\"));if(order.some(i=>i<0)||order[0]>order[1]||order[1]>order[2]){console.error('LIVE-934: the page index catalog does not list Site, Lead and SEO, System in that order');process.exit(1)}if(/\\?edit=1/.test(inapp)){console.error('LIVE-934: the in-app list links ?edit=1 again, a parameter no listed page reads');process.exit(1)}const ids=['pages-marketing','pages-lead-seo','pages-splash-funnels','pages-in-app-member','pages-system'];const pos=ids.map(id=>mods.indexOf(\"'\"+id+\"',\"));if(pos.some(p=>p<0)||pos.some((p,i)=>i&&p<pos[i-1])){console.error('LIVE-934: PAGES_MODULE_IDS is not Site, Lead and SEO, Funnels, In-app, System');process.exit(1)}"
